EVERYDAY FUN · BRIGHT LAB

Snack Shop Creator!

Build your own sandwich, sundae, or snack mix — then tell us all about it!

HOW THIS WORKS

Instructions

Everyone gets a turn at the snack shop counter!

  • 🛒 Step 1: Pick a shop: Sandwich, Sundae, or Snack Mix.
  • 👆 Step 2: Tap ingredients to add them to your creation. Tap again to take them off.
  • ✅ Step 3: Tap "Finish & Save This Snack" when you're happy with it.
  • 💬 Step 4: Answer the questions about your creation, then pass the turn to the next student.
  • 🔁 There are 7 turns total — enough for the whole group to build something!
BEFORE WE START

Materials

Just one thing needed for this game.

  • 🖥️ A device or screen where students can see and tap the snack shop counter.
